description: Returns one bot's verified manifest: ok, official, class, free_per_day, price_tfuel, current_ref and its cards (sha256_ok each). Give name OR ref, not both (name wins). Use after bots_discover, before bots_call. Read-only, free, no key. Unknown bot: error not_found.

ref.description: Or its listing ref from bots_discover, v3:N, e.g. v3:142

name: bots_inspect
title: Inspect a bot
